description: Convert the 97 static source-grep tests to behavioral tests in per-domain batches, make upload writes session-authoritative for school scoping, and stop upload/csv from returning 500 on duplicate emails.
deviation_notes: Spec FR-1 said 97 static source-grep tests; the Phase 1 inventory measured 149 cases (+54%) under one-case-per-it counting. All 149 resolved: converted to behavioral, kept with justification (2 locale data pins, 2 message-JSON pins, 2 config pins, 1 architecture ratchet), or deleted as duplicates of existing behavioral coverage. Upload Green landed via two agents after a provider quota cut: the second agent fixed three defects in the first's partial work (skippedExisting undercount, classroom-assignment email case bug, Red-test TS2571). One production defect found and fixed during conversion: task-lesson-summary crashed on lessons without flashcard rows. Independent review follow-up (2026-09-14): installed the promised no-restricted-imports lint gate for the console module, made the i18n-Link and unauthorized-page tests two-property discriminative (marker mock + real-Link locale-prefix render, backed by inlining next-intl's navigation ESM in vitest config), and pinned the mixed-case CSV email path with a classroom-assignment assertion.
